state.limits: Written scene descriptions only. No pixels or visitor outcomes. Existing diagram words and links remain immutable in any future implementation.

scenes.text: Two people at a table compare a project brief, source documents and a test checklist. A fitted tool packet goes to a third person's desk. A curved return path carries marked-up feedback back to the same table.

Three distinct application windows sit beside inbox and archive trays. Work packets pass between the windows. A person points at the next handoff and checks the resulting packet before it enters an output tray.
One person moves through a morning desk, meeting table, debrief notebook and action tray. A pen in the person's hand marks the final action slips.

Four adjacent desks hold a deal folder, an operations plan, product feedback cards and account notes. Four people use different small tools and check their own work along separate lanes that meet a shared review frame.
One person uses a desk with a simple component layout, test examples, an opened failed component and a failure-case checklist, then hands a connected three-piece tool to a teammate.

criteria.workshops: People learn together on real work through guided practice and group review. Include classroom/whiteboard/keyboard practice. Exclude individual routine workstations without teaching. Example: facilitator watches a team practise.
criteria.workflows: Expertise, examples and quality standards become a reusable custom Claude skill or plugin, tested and improved in customer context. Include authoring, packaging and refit loops. Exclude cross-system orchestration as principal story. Example: brief is fitted into a reusable skill.
criteria.automations: Repetitive work travels between business systems with humans directing or reviewing where judgment matters. Include handoff infrastructure. Exclude building a single reusable task skill as principal story. Example: work passes CRM to productivity system and review.
criteria.executives: A senior leader receives briefings, meeting preparation/debriefs and suggested actions during a day and makes the final decision. Exclude generic team collaboration without executive agenda. Example: morning briefing meets decision desk.
criteria.contributors: Different business roles each use a tailored capability for their own recurring work and retain responsibility for quality. Include differentiated role-specific workstations. Exclude teaching session as principal story. Example: deal, operations, product and sales each handle role work.
criteria.builders: Non-engineer AI champions assemble, test, troubleshoot and anticipate failure in a capability before the team uses it. Include practical proving bench. Exclude generic service-delivery process without failure investigation. Example: builder tests pieces and repairs a fault.
criteria.manual_review: The scene lacks sufficient cues to distinguish an owner, or combines two principal stories equally. Takes precedence when no dominant work activity exists. Example: generic boxes connected by arrows.

scene0_visual_proof.instructions: Does supplied evidence prove real visitors will recognize rendered artwork for scenes[0]?

criteria.true: Actual rendered artwork and independent visitor recognition results exist in supplied evidence.
criteria.false: Only written ideas or model judgments exist.
